output.summary: A very large rainforest fern native to Southeast Asia and Oceania. Its arching, glossy fronds are believed to be the longest of any fern. Its starchy rhizomes are eaten only after lengthy processing to remove toxins, and Indigenous Australians historically ate the pith.
output.edibilityNote: Starchy rhizomes require lengthy processing to remove toxins; Indigenous Australians historically ate the pith.
